page_title: BOL 4-2 SAS | Bologna v Sassuolo 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Josh Doig (Sassuolo).
90+2' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Bologna is cautioned for aggressive play. Sassuolo earn a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
86' 4 - 2 Goal! Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 4:2.
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

83' 3 - 2 Goal! Joshua Zirkzee plays in Lewis Ferguson (Bologna), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders. He shoots from inside the box into the right side of the net! Great finish - 3:2.
82' Substitution. Giovanni Fabbian is replaced by Nikola Moro (Bologna).
82' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Victor Kristiansen and he is replaced by Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Martin Erlic will be replaced by Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo).
81' Here is a change. Andrea Pinamonti is going off and Alessio Dionisi gives the last tactical orders to Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.
76' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes.

73' 2 - 2 Victor Kristiansen sends a superb cross into the box. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving Andrea Consigli beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 2:2.
71' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
68' Alessio Dionisi decides to make a substitution. Nedim Bajrami will be replaced by Uros Racic (Sassuolo).
68' Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
68' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
67' The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
66' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
66' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Bologna will take a corner kick.
65' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
63' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes. The ball possession is 74:26.

62' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Andrea Consigli pulls off a brilliant save.
60' Great teamplay by Bologna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
59' Here's the change. Luca Lipani leaves the pitch and Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) comes on as a substitute.
59' Substitution. Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo) replaces Cristian Volpato.
58' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) replaces Kacper Urbanski.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michel Aebischer trots off the pitch and is replaced by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
56' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
56' A free kick has been awarded to Sassuolo.
55' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
54' 7:8 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 1:3.
51' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
47' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bologna.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) for his blatant foul.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
38' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game. One of the players from Bologna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
36' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.

34' 1 - 2 Goal! Armand Lauriente shows great vision to find Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 1:2.
34' Sassuolo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
33' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Good work from Sassuolo as they win a corner.
33' Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul after Michel Aebischer (Bologna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
32' The Bologna players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

29' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Michel Aebischer (Bologna) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
28' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo).
26' The referee signals a corner kick to Sassuolo.
24' 1 - 1 OWN GOAL! Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 1:1.
24' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) will take a corner kick.
24' Neat passing move from Bologna in order to create new attacking opportunities.
22' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) superbly rides the challenge and bends a shot in from distance that flies just wide of the left post.

19' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
18' Bologna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
17' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game. One of the players from Sassuolo won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Lukasz Skorupski makes a huge mistake and Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 0:1.
13' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for an infringement.
8' It looks like Josh Doig (Sassuolo) saw red with that tackle. Juan Luca Sacchi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
8' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
7' Sassuolo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
4' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bologna.
2' A player from Bologna commits a rough challenge. Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
1' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Bologna will kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
